dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How goes your forged blades? Are they worthy of battle?

dialogues.speaker: Schulz
dialogues.text: I am far from perfecting my craft, but the blades are better than before. They're still not sharp enough, though...

dialogues.speaker: Schulz
dialogues.text: Here, take these. They should serve well to protect you. Besides, I cannot give any of them to Herman...

dialogues.speaker: Schulz
dialogues.text: I must forge a far better sword, one deemed worthy of Mr. Herman's kindness.
